Cloud Application Tenant Resource Get Org Cloud App Tenants Without Policy Info
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/casbTenant/lite

Retrieves information about the SaaS application tenant. .

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
activeOnly
boolean

Indicates that the tenant is in use. Policies are enforced for this SaaS application.

Default value: true
includeDeleted
boolean
Default value: false
appType
string

Possible values: [ANY, FILE, EMAIL, CRM, ITSM, COLLAB, REPO, STORAGE, TP_APP, MISC, GENAI]

Specifies the SaaS application type

app
string

Possible values: [SLACK, MSTEAM, WEBEX, MSTEAM_GCC_HIGH, MSTEAM_DOD, MSTEAM_GCC_MOD, ZOOM, TRELLO, SALESFORCE, MSFT_DYNAMICS365, TWILIO, EXCHANGE, GMAIL, EXCHANGE_GCC_HIGH, EXCHANGE_DOD, EXCHANGE_GCC_MOD, BOX, ONEDRIVE, SHAREPOINT, DROPBOX, GOOGLEDRIVE, SHAREFILE, CONFLUENCE, ONEDRIVE_GCC_HIGH, ONEDRIVE_DOD, SHAREPOINT_GCC_HIGH, SHAREPOINT_DOD, ONEDRIVE_GCC_MOD, SHAREPOINT_GCC_MOD, SMARTSHEET, CHATGPT, MSFTCOPILOT, SERVICENOW, JIRA, JUMPCLOUD, MS_ATP_DEFENDER, GSUITE, OFFICE365, MIP, OKTA, OFFICE365_GCC_HIGH, OFFICE365_DOD, OFFICE365_GCC_MOD, APPTOTAL, WORKDAY, GITHUB, BITBUCKET, GITLAB, AWSS3, AZUREBLOB, GCPSTORAGE, GSUITE_MARKETPLACE, MSOFFICE365_MARKETPLACE, SLACK_MARKETPLACE, SALESFORCE_MARKETPLACE]

Specifies the sanctioned SaaS application

scanConfigTenantsOnly
boolean

Specifies the tenant for which the scan is already configured

Default value: false
includeBucketReadyS3Tenants
boolean

For the AWS S3 SaaS application, this parameter indicates that the buckets have been read and are ready for use in policies and scan configurations.

Default value: false
filterByFeature
string[]

Possible values: [CASB, WORKFLOW_AUTOMATION, SSPM, ACTIVITY_REPORT, TP_APP_REPORT, RT_DLP, APP_GOVERNANCE, REDACTION, CASB_ENTITY_GROUP]

Filters the SaaS application tenant by feature

page
int32

Specifies the page offset

pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation
